title: 第11章 无名小女孩第十二章 幽火草
content_zh:
“嗯！”
小女孩艰难起身，奋起跑去，可黑色巨蟒的速度，比她更快，如闪电直击般，让人避无可避。
“炎心诀！”
炽热的火焰，应无无悔手中甩出，直接击中黑色巨蟒头部，黑色巨蟒一愣，摇了摇头，什么实质性伤害都没有，黑色巨蟒又一身巨吼，头部着地面疯狂砸去，应无悔用异能强化全身，抱起小女孩，疯狂向后跑去。
这灵魂，就说有异能兽，可他什么也不说清楚，我以为异能兽，也就比普通的野兽强一些，谁想到强的不是一星半点？他也不教我如何识别，如何去击杀，好歹我也是异能师，超越普通人五六倍的身体素质，可面对这家伙，就如同大人打小孩一样。
黑色巨蟒穷追不舍，应无悔蛇皮走位，躲过了一次又一次致命一击。
黑色巨蟒发怒了，它又暴吼一声，全身燃起熊熊的烈焰，它的行进速度变得更快，应无悔在异能的强化下，已经跑的非常快，而它的速度是两个应无悔！
这是一场死亡追逐游戏，我完全打不过这头巨蟒，我的炎心诀，对他造成不了一丝伤害，它身体上的鳞片，厚如铠甲，即使我受到异能的强化，拳头硬的跟木头一样，但是对于它，却是棉花。
只有跑到灵活那里，才有可能活命！
黑色巨蟒的距离，离应无悔越来越近，不过快到洞穴，有希望！
应无悔边跑边向后面投掷火焰，进行骚扰，黑色巨蟒十分不耐烦，但它的前进速度也会受到一小些影响。
还有100米，黑色巨蟒张开血盆大口，他们之间的距离，只有一两厘米，美味就要得手，黑色巨蟒的大口越张越大，粗长的獠牙，滴着唾液。
“灵魂，救我！”
应无悔扔出小女孩，中年人的灵魂释放能量，轻轻一缕，便浮住小女孩。
“连个一级异能中阶的孽畜都打不过”
中年人的灵魂一摇头，飞出一缕蓝色光波，那黑色巨蟒就直接被击倒在地，动弹了几下，便死了。
“呼呼呼！
谢谢你啊，又是你救了我，差点又死了，有什么对付异能兽的方法吗？这个你可以教一下我”
应无悔喘着粗气问道。
“没有，这个世界弱肉强食，没有绝对的方法可以让你办成任何事，但你只要有绝对的力量，那就可以做到任何事”

中年人的灵魂严肃道，“这条孽畜叫焱火蟒，火属性异能兽，一级异能中阶，和你的炎心诀适配，吸收了它”
说完，中年人的灵魂便飞向洞内深处。
黑色巨蟒身体冒出红色的光芒，从它中间身体处升起了一个圆形的光球，光球在慢慢的往上升，应无悔上前抓住手中，这颗光球红红的，摸上去像一个珠子。
应无悔走到小女孩旁边，“你叫什么名字？”
小女孩没有说话，只是开心的看着他，“小妹妹，你不会？不会讲话吧？”
content_en:
"Yeah!"
The little girl got up with difficulty and ran away, but the black python was faster than her. It was like a lightning strike, making it impossible for people to avoid it.
"Fire Heart Technique!"
Ying Wuhui threw out the blazing flames from his hand and directly hit the black python's head. The black python was stunned and shook its head. There was no real damage. The black python roared again and hit its head on the ground. Ying Wuhui strengthened his whole body with superpowers, picked up the little girl, and ran back crazily.
This soul said that there was a supernatural beast, but he didn't explain anything clearly. I thought that the supernatural beast was just a little stronger than an ordinary beast. Who would have thought that it wasn't even a little bit stronger? He didn't teach me how to identify or kill him. After all, I am also a psychic, with five or six times the physical fitness of ordinary people. But facing this guy is like an adult beating a child.
The giant black python was chasing after him, and Ying Wuhui moved his snake skin, avoiding fatal blows again and again.
The black giant python was angry. It roared again, and its whole body was ignited with raging flames. Its traveling speed became faster. With the enhancement of superpowers, Ying Wuhui was already running very fast, and its speed was two Ying Wuhui!
This is a death chasing game. I can't beat this giant python at all. My Flame Heart Technique can't cause any harm to him. The scales on its body are as thick as armor. Even if I am strengthened by supernatural powers and my fist is as hard as wood, to it, it is like cotton.
Only by running to Flexibility can you possibly survive!
The distance of the black giant python is getting closer and closer to Ying Wuhui, but it is almost to the cave, there is hope!
Ying Wuhui ran while throwing flames behind him to harass him. The black python was very impatient, but its forward speed would also be slightly affected.
There were still 100 meters to go, and the black giant python opened its bloody mouth. The distance between them was only one or two centimeters, and the delicious food was about to be obtained. The black giant python opened its mouth wider and wider, and its long and thick fangs were dripping with saliva.
"Soul, save me!"
Ying Wuhui threw the little girl out, and the middle-aged man's soul released energy and floated the little girl with a light ray.
"I can't even beat a mid-level evil beast with first-level superpowers."
The middle-aged man's soul shook his head and flew out a ray of blue light. The black python was knocked to the ground, moved a few times, and then died.
“Hoo ho ho!
Thank you. You saved me again and almost died again. Is there any way to deal with the supernatural beast? You can teach me this”
Ying Wuhui asked while breathing heavily.
"No, in this world the jungle is the strongest. There is no absolute way for you to accomplish anything, but as long as you have absolute power, you can do anything."
The soul of the middle-aged man said solemnly, "This evil beast is called Yanhuo Python. It is a fire-attributed supernatural beast. It is a mid-level first-level supernatural power. It is adapted to your Flame Heart Technique and absorbed it."
After saying that, the middle-aged man's soul flew deep into the cave.
Red light emitted from the black python's body, and a round ball of light rose from its middle body. The ball of light was slowly rising. Ying Wuhui stepped forward and grabbed it in his hand. The ball of light was red and felt like a bead.
Ying Wuhui walked up to the little girl and asked, "What's your name?"
The little girl didn't speak, just looked at him happily, "Little sister, you can't? You can't speak, can you?"
